title: Observability for Fabric Data Agent in Microsoft Foundry (Preview)

content.text: Observability for Fabric Data Agent in Microsoft Foundry (Preview) surfaces telemetry for every call to a Fabric Data Agent used as a tool inside a Foundry agent, including latency, status, and error details, so agent builders can debug and monitor production agents. For more information, see Fabric data agent concepts.
